campaign_objective: Historical diplomatic expansion (Anschluss, Sudetenland, Fate of Czechoslovakia), defeat Poland, Low Countries, and France, execute Operation Sea Lion against UK, defeat USSR (Operation Barbarossa), and secure peace conference.

phase_1_buildup_1936_1938.industrial_policy: Build civilian factories until early 1937, then pivot heavily to military factories, synthetic refineries, and rail infrastructure in high-infrastructure core states.
phase_1_buildup_1936_1938.field_force: Maintain required fielded division manpower to trigger Anschluss (550k) and Sudetenland (750k) on schedule.

phase_2_diplomacy_and_poland_1939.war_window: FAIR window begins July 1939. Secure Danzig or War.
phase_2_diplomacy_and_poland_1939.poland_campaign: Double pincer from Pomerania and Silesia to encircle Warsaw. Keep western border (Siegfried Line) firmly garrisoned against France.
phase_2_diplomacy_and_poland_1939.post_poland: Redeploy assault panzer divisions west, build up air bases in western Germany.

phase_3_fall_gelb_france_1940.axis_of_advance: Attack through the Low Countries (Netherlands, then Belgium) avoiding the Maginot Line.
phase_3_fall_gelb_france_1940.spearhead: Panzers punch through the Ardennes toward Sedan and the English Channel, cutting off Allied armies in Flanders. Capture Paris to capitulate France.

phase_4_sea_lion_and_uk.prerequisites: Air superiority over the English Channel/Southern England, concentrated naval bombers, fleet escort patrol, 10 marine/infantry landing divisions.
phase_4_sea_lion_and_uk.execution: Land near Dover/Portsmouth, capture port, quickly ferry follow-on panzer corps, drive north to capitulate the United Kingdom.

phase_5_barbarossa_ussr.frontline: Organize 3 Army Groups (North: Leningrad; Center: Moscow/Smolensk; South: Ukraine/Caucasus).
phase_5_barbarossa_ussr.operational_art: Prioritize massive frontier encirclements around Bialystok, Minsk, and Kiev. Follow railway lines to keep supply hubs online.
